luci-app-netpath.description: NetPath dashboard: read-only status of the device, uplink, radios and stations (wireless configuration without keys, through luci.netpath wireless), its temperature sensors (luci.netpath thermal), the wired hosts its bridges have learned (luci.netpath wired: MAC, port and when last heard, and which switch ports a port's VLAN has) and the link state of those switch ports (luci getSwconfigPortState)

luci-app-netpath-rdns.description: NetPath dashboard: client names from reverse DNS (lets the holder make the device send DNS PTR queries to any DNS server and port it names)

luci-app-netpath-names.description: NetPath dashboard: name stations (luci.netpath set_alias: validated names in /etc/config/netpath only, at most 512)
